title: Weighted BiLSTM Toxicity Classifier
summary: The solution tokenizes lowercased comments with a regex, truncates to 220 tokens, builds a training-derived vocabulary using minimum frequency 5 and a 200,000-type cap, and maps pruned or validation-only tokens to unknown IDs. A learned embedding with spatial dropout feeds two stacked bidirectional LSTMs. Masked temporal max and mean pooling are concatenated, passed through a ReLU dense layer and residual ReLU dense layer, and projected to one toxicity logit plus identity auxiliary logits. Training uses weighted binary cross-entropy for toxicity, up-weighting identity-mention, non-identity toxic, and identity non-toxic examples, plus unweighted auxiliary identity BCE. Batches are shuffled with local length bucketing and dynamically padded. Adam optimization uses mixed-precision gradient scaling, gradient-norm clipping, and exponential learning-rate decay after each of six epochs. Inference length-buckets validation comments, applies sigmoid to the toxicity logit, and evaluates continuous probabilities.
